title: Authenticity and Nepalese Food in West London
episode_summary: James Staples and Luke Heslop visit Namaste Ghurkha restaurant in West London and speak with proprietor Indra Hang Lindon about Nepalese food, migration, identity and adapting traditional cuisine for life in the UK. Indra discusses maintaining authentic Nepalese flavours while adapting menus for British customers, the importance of food memories, and how restaurants help preserve cultural identity among migrant communities.
main_topics: South Asian diaspora in West London
migration_themes: Migration from Nepal to the UK
Building a restaurant business after migration
important_quotes: Food is something through which identity is expressed.
Authentic is one part, but you have to be realistic as well.
